ANTIFRAUD::alert_additional_info
Description
This iRules command returns a list of keys and values that describes
integrity parameters check failure or parameter values too long error.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_additional_info
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert additional info: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_additional_info]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
